description: Experiment A v2 must include at least one replicate.
Removal should increase final total shoot biomass versus present.
Removal should increase final fine fuel proxy versus present.
Removal should increase final browseable biomass versus present.
At least 80 percent of seeds should show positive total shoot delta.
At least 80 percent of seeds should show positive fine fuel delta.
At least 80 percent of seeds should show positive browseable delta.
Daily drinking water should rise from low to high aridity.
Daily dry matter intake should decline from low to high stress in at least one matrix axis.
Mean intake at high stress should be lower than low stress.
